g.text: Server CPU cost — lower is better

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #22334a

g.text: Sorted-set performance on matched AWS hardware

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536174

g.text: 8-CPU quota · 8 GiB per engine · separate client host · persistence disabled

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536174

g.text: Medians of 3 × 60 seconds · 32 connections · pipeline 16 · ~80% ZINCRBY / 20% ZRANK.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536174

g.text: Throughput whiskers: min–max. Mixed traffic: 24 hot connections; 8 cold connections across 63 other keys.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536174

g.text: 262,144 members per dataset. 1,024-set tests used a fresh matched host pair of the same types.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536174

g.text: Adaptive ownership is off by default and stayed inactive in uniform tests. Fixed concurrency, not peak capacity.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536174

g.text: September 28–29, 2026 · All 36 measurements passed data, client CPU and network checks.
